factual_claims.claim: The EBITDA loss narrowed to DKK 2.0m from DKK 9.3m, while the net loss declined to DKK 6.6m from DKK 14.9m.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Highlights and Key Figures table shows EBITDA loss of DKK (1,990k) in 2025 vs DKK (9,290k) in 2024. Income Statement shows profit/loss for the year of DKK (6,621k) in 2025 vs DKK (14,866k) in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The improvement reflected stronger revenue, lower marketing and external costs, and the impact of outsourcing marketing activities, which management states reduced the EBIT loss by DKK 3m.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Review 2025 states: 'In 2024, Konsolidator decided to outsource many of the marketing department's activities. The full impact of the outsourcing reduced the EBIT loss by 3m in 2025.' Also notes reduced external expenses.

factual_claims.claim: Other operating income also increased to DKK 2.0m from DKK 0.7m, including income associated with a commercial partner agreement.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Income Statement shows Other operating income of DKK 2,026k in 2025 vs DKK 678k in 2024. Letter from the Chair and CEO mentions: 'In September 2025, Konsolidator signed an agreement with Exsitec AB, making them a fully-fledged service provider partner... This move positively impacted the EBITDA margin.'

factual_claims.claim: In the second half, EBITDA turned positive at DKK 0.5m, compared with a DKK 3.6m loss in H2 2024, and operating cash flow improved to positive DKK 0.1m from negative DKK 3.6m.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Periodic Reporting 2025 section states: 'Konsolidator reached a financial milestone... as H2 2025 showed a positive EBITDA by DKK 0.5m compared to a loss in H2 2024 by DKK 3.6m.' Cash flow from operating activities was positive DKK 0.1m in H2 2025 vs negative DKK 3.6m in H2 2024.

factual_claims.claim: SaaS efficiency indicators improved overall.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: SaaS Metrics 2025 section shows improvements in Rule of 40, CAC payback, CLV/CAC, and net retention, confirming overall efficiency gains.

factual_claims.claim: The Rule of 40 score increased to 17% from negative 40%, reflecting 25% revenue growth and an EBITDA margin of negative 8%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: SaaS Metrics 2025 section states: 'The Rule of 40 improved to 17% at year-end, up from -40% in 2024. Revenue growth amounted to 25% in 2025... The EBITDA margin was -8% for 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: CAC payback improved to 23 months from 43 months, with customer acquisition costs down 32%, primarily because of lower marketing expenditure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: SaaS Metrics 2025 section states: 'The CAC Payback Period was down to 23 months in 2025 from 43 months in 2024... Customer acquisition costs were down 32% from 2024 to 2025. This positive development was substantially driven by lower marketing costs compared to the previous year.'

factual_claims.claim: CLV/CAC rose to 4.1 from 2.7.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: SaaS Metrics 2025 section states: 'CLV/CAC climbed from 2.7 in 2024 to 4.1 in 2025.'

factual_claims.claim: However, ARR churn worsened to 12.6% from 10.5%, while net retention remained 94%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: SaaS Metrics 2025 section states: 'In 2025, ARR churn rate was 12.6% compared to 10.5% in 2024... In 2025 Net Retention remained unchanged compared to 2024 at 94%.'

factual_claims.claim: The report attributes increased churn among established customers partly to growing demand for FP&A capabilities and ERP systems meeting the needs of smaller groups.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: SaaS Metrics 2025 section states: 'In 2025, Konsolidator experienced increased churn among established customers as the need for FP&A tools became more prominent and ERP systems increasingly addressed smaller groups' consolidation needs.'

factual_claims.claim: Strategically, Konsolidator transitioned from a single consolidation product to the broader Konsolidator Suite, launching a financial data management solution and developing an FP&A tool, which attracted its first customers before launch.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Strategy section states expansion to Konsolidator Suite including Financial Data Management solution launched in April 2025 and FP&A tool development started in May 2025, with first customers signed ahead of launch.

factual_claims.claim: Partner-led sales accounted for 38% of new customers versus 22% in 2024, supporting the company’s scalable growth model.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Letter from the Chair and CEO states: 'In 2025, 38% of new customers were acquired through partners, compared to 22% in 2024.' Strategy section also discusses partner-driven growth.

factual_claims.claim: The Iberian subsidiary expanded to 30 customers and became the third-largest market.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Insight: Konsolidator Iberia section states: 'Since its launch, it has grown 200% (from 10 to 30 customers) and is now the third-largest market by customer count.'

factual_claims.claim: Despite improved operations, consolidated equity remained negative at DKK 3.6m, compared with negative DKK 2.4m, and cash was only DKK 0.4m at year-end.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial Review 2025 states: 'Konsolidator had a negative consolidated equity of DKK 3.6m at year-end... However, Konsolidator A/S had a positive equity of DKK 0.7m.' Balance Sheet shows cash and cash equivalents of DKK 370k.

factual_claims.claim: Two private placements raised DKK 4.8m, while loan repayments began during the year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Shareholder Information section states: 'In 2025, Konsolidator issued 1,314,054 shares in two private placements... The two capital increases secured net proceeds of DKK 4.8m.' Financial Review mentions loan repayments commenced in July 2025.

factual_claims.claim: For 2026, management guides to CARR and revenue of DKK 27–29m and positive EBITDA of DKK 1–2m, with expected churn of 6–9%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook 2026 section provides exact guidance: 'CARR: DKK 27–29m... Revenue: DKK 27–29m... EBITDA: DKK 1–2m... Churn is expected to decline to a level between 6-9%.'
